good.message: Conditions Are Suitable for Outdoor Activity
good.note: Air quality and temperature are within a safe range. Breathing should remain steady and symptoms unlikely.
recommendations: Feel free to enjoy outdoor walking or running.
Warm up and cool down properly.

caution.note: Either temperature or air quality is close to your sensitivity threshold. Activity is possible but monitor your breathing.
recommendations: Reduce intensity if you feel chest tightness.

bad.message: Air Quality or Temperature Is Unsuitable for Outdoor Activity
bad.note: PM2.5 levels or temperature exceed your personal safe threshold for asthma. Outdoor exercise may worsen respiratory symptoms.
recommendations: Check again later for improved conditions.
Consider wearing a mask if you must go outside briefly.
